client.name: Player Movement System
client.description: First-person/third-person character movement with collision detection

client.name: Block Interaction System
client.description: Block placement, removal, and interaction mechanics

client.name: Chunk Management System
client.description: Chunk loading, unloading, and rendering coordination

client.name: Inventory System
client.description: Item storage, management, and UI integration

client.name: Camera System
client.description: Third-person camera with smooth following and rotation

client.name: Input System
client.description: Keyboard, mouse, and touch input handling

client.name: UI System Framework
client.description: Base UI manager and popup system

client.name: Game State Management
client.description: Game state transitions and mode management

server.name: Session Management
server.description: Player session tracking and lifecycle management

server.name: Network Transport Layer
server.description: TCP socket communication and message routing

server.name: Database Integration
server.description: Persistent storage for chunks and player data

server.name: World Map Control
server.description: World generation profile management and versioning

client.name: Terrain Rendering
client.description: Voxel-based terrain mesh generation and rendering

client.name: Health and Hunger System
client.description: Player health, hunger, and survival mechanics

client.name: Day/Night Cycle
client.description: Time of day lighting and sky changes

client.name: Mob System
client.description: Animal and monster spawning and AI

server.name: Terrain Generation Algorithms
server.description: Procedural terrain generation with noise functions

server.name: Cave Generation
server.description: Underground cave systems with hydrology awareness

server.name: River Generation
server.description: Procedural river networks with flow simulation

server.name: Lake Generation
server.description: Lake basin formation and water body placement

client.name: Memory Management
client.description: Soft object pointers and memory optimization

client.name: AI Behavior Tree
client.description: Behavior tree framework for entity AI

caves.description: Hydrology-aware cave generation with improved algorithms
improvements: Hydrology stability weighting for cave suppression
Edge sealing to prevent chunk boundary artifacts
Support pillar generation for structural integrity
Riparian cave plugging for water table consistency

rivers.description: Flow-aware river generation with watershed management
improvements: Hydrology flow accumulation for river width
Watershed stitching for seamless chunk transitions
River proximity suppression for lake placement
Shoreline jitter for natural lake edges
Basin smoothing for lake depth consistency

server.description: Enhanced world map control with profile management
features: WorldMapController for centralized chunk generation and caching
WorldMapControlProfile for versioning and hash-based validation
Generation signature computation for cache invalidation
Map scale and coordinate display options

protobuf_protocol_validation.description: Protobuf packet protocol review and validation

messages: PlayerInfo - PlayerId, Username, Position, Level, Health, MaxHealth, Inventory
WorldBlockChangeRequest - AreaId, SubworldId, BlockPosition, BlockType, ChunkType
WorldBlockChangeBroadcast - AreaId, SubworldId, BlockPosition, BlockType, ChunkType, PlayerId, Timestamp

recommendations: All protobuf messages are properly generated and structured
Proper use of Vector3Int and Vector3 types

data_driven_approach.description: Data-driven architecture for game configuration and content
implemented: World generation parameters in JSON format
World map control profiles in JSON format
needed_improvements: Complete block type system with all properties
Complete item system with all item types
Mob spawn configurations in JSON format

next_steps: 1. Verify all using statements and class references
2. Run compilation tests for server and client
7. Complete block and item data files
